kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic أَوَّل (ʔawwal)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic أولي
From أَوَّل (ʔawwal, “first”) + ـِيّ (-iyy).
g: prime, primary, primordial, original, initial, first

أُولِي • (ʔūlī) (form I) /ʔuː.liː/
# second-person feminine singular imperative of آلَ (ʔāla)

g: priority (goal of a person or an organization)

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Proto-West Semitic *ʔalyat- (“fat tail, tail fat”). Cognate to Classical Syriac ܐܠܝܬܐ (ʾellīṯā) and Hebrew אַלְיָה ('alyá).
Relative noun (nisba) composed of أَوَّل (ʔawwal) + ـِيَّة (-iyya).
s: Relative noun (nisba) composed of أَوَّل (ʔawwal) + ـِيَّة (-iyya)
